description.ja: Figure-rise Standard ピッコロがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Figure-rise Standard Piccolo is now available with a renewed package! !

description.ja: • パワーアップしたマッスルビルドシステムにより、ピッコロの特徴的な腕の筋肉を成形色のみで再現！
description.en: • With the powered-up muscle build system, Piccolo's characteristic arm muscles are reproduced using only molded colors!

description.ja: • さらに、可動もパワーアップ！肩と腕の引き出し関節により腕組みポーズも可能に！
description.en: • In addition, the movement is powered up! The arms can be posed with folded arms thanks to the pull-out joints in the shoulders and arms!

description.ja: • ピッコロの代名詞マントとターバンが付属し、様々なシーンのピッコロが楽しめる！
description.en: • Piccolo's signature cloak and turban are included, so you can enjoy Piccolo in various scenes!

description.ja: • 他のキャラクターと組み合わせて遊びの幅がさらに広がる新パーツ「ドラマティックパーツ」には「超サイヤ人 孫悟飯」の頭髪パーツが付属！師弟コンビの劇中シーンが再現可能に！
description.en: • New parts "Dramatic Parts " that can be combined with other characters to further expand the range of play include " Super Saiyan Son Gohan" hair parts! Scenes from the play of the teacher-pupil duo can now be recreated!

description.ja: • エフェクトパーツはピッコロの必殺技「魔貫光殺砲」が付属！
description.en: • Effect parts include Piccolo's special move "Makan Kosatsuhou"!

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト（魔貫光殺砲）×1
accessories.en: Special move effect (Magical light killing gun) x 1

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ3種（平常、怒り、ターバン着用（平常））×各1
accessories.en: 3 types of facial expression parts (normal, angry, wearing turban (normal)) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ2種（左右握り手、魔貫光殺砲用右手）×各1
accessories.en: 2 types of wrist parts (left and right gripping hands, right hand for Makankosatsu gun) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 超サイヤ人孫悟飯用　頭髪パーツ×1
accessories.en: Hair parts for Super Saiyan Son Gohan x 1
